t: 君士坦提乌斯二世皇帝在奇里乞亚的莫普苏埃斯蒂亚因发烧去世；临终前，他接受了洗礼，并宣布他的表弟…
te: Emperor Constantius II dies of a fever at Mopsuestia in Cilicia; on his deathbed he is baptised and declares his cousin…
dz: 君士坦提乌斯二世皇帝在奇里乞亚的莫普苏埃斯蒂亚因发烧去世；临终前，他接受了洗礼，并宣布他的表弟朱利安为合法继承人。
de: Emperor Constantius II dies of a fever at Mopsuestia in Cilicia; on his deathbed he is baptised and declares his cousin Julian rightful successor.

t: 朱利安作为唯一的罗马皇帝进入君士坦丁堡.
te: Julian enters Constantinople as sole Roman Emperor.
dz: 朱利安作为唯一的罗马皇帝进入君士坦丁堡.
de: Julian enters Constantinople as sole Roman Emperor.
